style: STYLE (applies to every image): a single illustration for a game card, in the same dark-field microscope style as the attached image. Pure black background. One clear subject, centred, filling about two thirds of the square, readable at small size. Translucent glowing bodies with a bright rim and a glassy darker interior, soft bloom. Colours with fixed meanings: pink (#FF5C8A) for the player's own cell, violet (#8B5CF6) only for native bystander cells, amber (#F5A524) for acid, waste and chemicals, green (#2DD4A7) only for immune activity. Clean, charming, slightly cute, scientific. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no border, no frame, no watermark.

Around its membrane are several small turnstile-like pumps, each pushing a tiny amber droplet back out of the cell, with little arcs showing the droplets leaving. The inside of the cell is clean and clear. This is a BIOLOGY card: everything looks organic, soft, slightly irregular and alive.
